scope:
One short static CPU profile of an explicitly supplied current frozen binary.
Prepared runner only. Execute serially after correctness/official runs; not ranking.
Source snapshot is Windows-git metadata.json plus source.diff; no WSL git invocation.

scheduling_delta.scope: Host includes loadgen and unrelated host work; last_processor is a snapshot, not residency. Per-TID utilization is CPU time / observed wall interval, not a blocking reason or connection ownership count.

limitations: Single perturbed diagnostic run; no ranking or stable speedup claim.
fp call graphs may truncate optimized frames; self samples are more reliable than inclusive allocation attribution.
No syscall/packet/allocator count is inferred from sampling percentages.
